model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the percentage of the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) that is attributed to the agricultural sector (% des BIP) for various countries. The horizontal axis represents the countries, while the vertical axis indicates the percentage of GDP. The chart includes two sets of bars for each country: one in blue representing the percentage of GDP from agriculture between 2021 and 2024, and one in green representing the percentage of GDP from agriculture in 2021. The bars are arranged in descending order from top to bottom, starting with Poland at the highest percentage and ending with Spain at the lowest. The blue bars show a consistent trend of being longer than the green bars, indicating that the percentage of GDP from agriculture is expected to increase from 2021 to 2024 for all listed countries. The chart also includes error bars, suggesting a range of uncertainty or variability in the data. The chart does not provide any additional information on the reasons for the changes or comparisons between the countries.
